subject: Round-2 findings applied to spec
body: Checked all 15 round-2 findings (NF1-NF7, M1-M8) and the two flagged citations (C8, C11) against the source files and applied every one; none was rejected, and each has a row in review/disposition-round2.md giving the spec line it changed. Three root causes were fixed once rather than patched per row: every command except workflow now writes its contract in its own per-dispatch run folder, received through its folder output flag, a file output path, or a new --run-dir flag (NF3, NF4, NF6, NF7); the outcome check reads adversarial's nested return_contract block and accepts dry_run (NF1, NF2); and the pr-submit row and decision D2 (b) no longer use ask, which matches WC-3 (NF5). The spec grew from 65,568 to 70,579 bytes, its placeholder scan is clean, no tracked file changed, and what remains is review 3 of 3 plus two new open questions (does every quick adversarial run write merge-log.md, and is the --run-dir name free).
